title: Config
description:
Config configures the OCI caches: the blob cache, which keeps blobs by digest, and the
reference cache, which keeps resolved tags and digests.

remotePolicy.description:
RemotePolicy controls whether the registry authorizes every access to cached content:
IfNotPresent (default) or Always. Always turns off the reference cache. See [RemotePolicy].

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: Duration
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description: Duration is a Go duration string such as 30s, 5m or 1h30m, or an integer number of nanoseconds.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: BlobCacheConfig
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
BlobCacheConfig configures the blob cache. Its entries are addressed by digest, so they
never go stale.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the blob cache on or off. Defaults to true.

maxBlobSize.description:
MaxBlobSize is the largest blob in bytes the blob cache stores. Larger blobs are fetched
as usual but not cached. Must be positive. Defaults to 20971520 (20 MiB).

maxTotalSize.description:
MaxTotalSize bounds the bytes the blob cache keeps on disk. When it is exceeded, the
least recently used blobs are removed. 0 means no limit. Must not be negative.
Defaults to no limit in the CLI and to 1073741824 (1 GiB) in the controller.

ttl.description:
TTL is the maximum age of an entry. Under the IfNotPresent remote policy, it is how long
a cached blob is served without asking the registry. Must be positive. Defaults to 10m.
See [typesv1.Duration] for the accepted forms.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: ReferenceCacheConfig
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
ReferenceCacheConfig configures the reference cache. It maps a tag or digest to the
descriptor the registry resolved it to, so repeated resolves need no registry request.

enabled.description:
Enabled turns the reference cache on or off. Defaults to true in the CLI and to false
in the controller. The Always remote policy turns it off regardless.

maxEntries.description:
MaxEntries is the number of tags and digests the reference cache keeps, for all
repositories together. When it is reached, the least recently used entry is removed.
Must be positive. Defaults to 10000.

ttl.description:
TTL is the maximum age of an entry. A tag moved in the registry resolves to its old
digest until the entry expires. Must be positive.
Defaults to 10m. See [typesv1.Duration] for the accepted forms.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: RemotePolicy
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
RemotePolicy controls whether the registry authorizes every access to cached content.
Set it to Always where callers with different registry access share the caches.

The zero value means [RemotePolicyIfNotPresent].

oneOf.description: RemotePolicyIfNotPresent returns cached content without contacting the registry.

RemotePolicyAlways asks the registry to authorize every cache hit. The reference cache is
then off: resolving a tag is the authorization itself.
